subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: Which skill activation modes should OpenClaw support across native and Codex harnesses, and should external loaders require a typed capability rather than a Skill tool-name convention?
rationale: The requested name check would establish new plugin ownership and instruction-authority semantics that cannot be safely inferred from tool presence alone.

options.title: Explicit activation contracts
options.body: Keep filesystem reads for discovery, define deterministic explicit activation, and use typed providers for external skill resources.

options.title: Skill-name convention
options.body: Prefer any available tool named Skill and accept collision, ownership, and trust ambiguity.

options.title: Direct reads only
options.body: Retain canonical SKILL.md reads and decline plugin-owned loading behavior.

recommendation.title: Explicit activation contracts
recommendation.body: Keep filesystem reads for discovery, define deterministic explicit activation, and use typed providers for external skill resources.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected cross-harness contract issue is the clearest current venue and ownership signal for this decision.
